q_main.name: Escape the Cinder Wake
q_main.summary: The evacuation ship's defense network has turned on its passengers, and reclaimers are boarding. Reach the launch craft Petrel and get off this ship.

wake.text: You woke in Transfer Cabin 4-C as the Cinder Wake left Haldis Reach. The purser wants every passenger at Muster Point B.

muster.text: Check in with Purser Dray in the Crew Commons. There is time to look around before the jump.

corridor.text: An explosion. The ship's defense network, WARDEN, has declared the passengers obstructions. Purser Dray begged you to help security in Transit Corridor C-3.

checkpoint.text: Officer Iona Rell is with you. The forward sections are behind the security checkpoint and its WARDEN-controlled blast door.

medical.text: Beyond the checkpoint lies the medical deck, where the wounded wait and a maintenance synthetic is fighting off WARDEN cutters.

engineering.text: The route to the launch bays runs through the engineering loop around the drive core, then the archive hold.

archive.text: Reclaimers from the Lantern Office are in the archive cargo hold, among thousands of stored minds. Command lies beyond.

command.text: Commander Ysolde Varr holds launch control. Nothing launches without her codes — or without a decision about what the Petrel carries.

bay.text: Evacuation Bay 2. The Petrel waits, and so does Marshal Teodor Quill.

belongings.text: Check your locker and operator's case

muster.text: Go to Muster Point B in the Crew Commons

checkin.text: Check in with Purser Hollis Dray

reach_corridor.text: Help ship's security in Transit Corridor C-3

pass_checkpoint.text: Get through the forward blast door (terminal, lock, scanner, or the maintenance crawlway)

cross_engineering.text: Cross the engineering loop to the archive hold

cross_archive.text: Get past the reclaimers to the command chamber

launch_decision.text: Decide what the Petrel carries, and secure launch authorization

resolve_bay.text: Deal with the reclaimers in Evacuation Bay 2

q_ward.name: The Sealed Ward
q_ward.summary: The medical deck's treatment reserve is nearly gone, three passengers are wounded in triage, and five more are sealed in a quarantined ward whose air scrubbers are failing.

decide.text: Dr. Ilse Varga has a finite reserve of trauma gel and more patients than doses. Behind the quarantine seal, five passengers are breathing failing air. Iona sealed that door on Commander Varr's order.

supplies.text: Decide how the medical reserve is used

ward.text: Decide the fate of the sealed passenger ward

transitions.reason: You left the medical deck's choices unmade. The ward's seal held; no one opened it.

q_lantern.name: Lantern in the Dark
q_lantern.summary: A Lantern Office scout is hiding wounded somewhere in the archive hold. The reclaimers claim the archives hold stolen minds; the crew says they hold proof of an atrocity. Find out which, and decide what the scout's life is worth.

find.text: Reclaimer signals in the archive hold suggest a scout was cut off from her squad. The archive index terminal may say what the cargo really is.

decide.text: You found Senna Thorne, wounded, in cold storage. What happens to her now is your call.

testimony.text: Recover the Vesper testimony from the archive index

q_restart.name: Cold Restart
q_restart.summary: Both coolant pumps in the engineering loop are down. Restarting them would stop the toxic venting, enable the archive hold's purge system and repower the evacuation bay's defense turrets.

pumps.text: Chief Engineer Osei Marsh's last log: restart both coolant pumps. A replacement seal can be fabricated at the workshop bench.
